scenes.title: Cooks and Waiters
scenes.summary: Max annoys the kitchen crew by hurrying their orders and criticizing their plating, sparking a feud between the cooks and the former cook.

scenes.title: The Lucky Little Elephant
scenes.summary: Elena gives Barinov a lucky elephant figurine and reminds him not to plan anything for tomorrow evening because they are going to the cinema.

scenes.title: Celebration in the Dining Room
scenes.summary: An ecstatic Nagiyev hands out money to the staff and orders free champagne for all fifteen guests in the dining room.

scenes.title: The Stamp in the Passport
scenes.summary: Nagiyev shows off his divorce stamp in his passport, sends Vika to organize champagne for the guests, and praises Kostya's work.

scenes.title: The Kitchen Championship
scenes.summary: Nagiyev gives Kostya a bag of strange mushrooms and orders festive food from Ilya, while Barinov joins the cooks' game in the kitchen.

scenes.title: Tickets to Spartak
scenes.summary: Barinov wins the kitchen game, Timur offers him VIP Spartak tickets, and Elena calls to cancel their movie plans for tomorrow.

scenes.title: The Gold Cigar Cutter
scenes.summary: Barinov buys Timur's VIP tickets, bets ten thousand rubles on Spartak, and finds his missing gold cigar cutter in the kitchen.

scenes.title: The Middle of the Workday
scenes.summary: Max tries to ask Vika about their future together, and Vika sarcastically tells him she is rushing off to see a lover.

scenes.title: I Forgive All Debts
scenes.summary: Barinov asks a celebrating Nagiyev for a salary raise, and Nagiyev forgives all of Barinov's debts instead.

scenes.title: Aspic with Horseradish
scenes.summary: Nagiyev fires Ilya for insulting his ex-wife Kristina and orders Max to bring him aspic with horseradish even though it is not on the menu.

scenes.title: No Receipt, No Dish
scenes.summary: A doctor advises Vika to have a child within the next two years, while in the kitchen the cooks refuse to make aspic for Max without a printed receipt.

scenes.title: Molecular Aspic
scenes.summary: Katya saves Max by preparing a molecular aspic with horseradish in minutes, and Nagiyev demands more extraordinary dishes from her.

scenes.title: Until the Last Guest
scenes.summary: High on the mushrooms he gave Kostya, Nagiyev insists that he is the last guest and orders Max and Katya to keep cooking for him.

scenes.title: The Master Is Lord
scenes.summary: Nagiyev dismisses Vika for the night, and Barinov's winning streak ends the moment he drops his lucky elephant figurine.

scenes.title: The Lost Talisman
scenes.summary: Barinov blames Elena's lost elephant figurine for his gambling losses, offending Elena, while at the restaurant Ilya comes for his final pay.

scenes.title: Searching for the Elephant
scenes.summary: Rodion finds Barinov's lucky elephant in the courtyard, Barinov orders the cooks to search everywhere for it, and Max keeps serving a spaced-out Nagiyev.

scenes.title: A Guy from the People
scenes.summary: Barinov tries to wake Nagiyev up in the dining room, and Nagiyev rehires Ilya and tries to make Barinov taste Katya's molecular dish.

scenes.title: A Reasonable Person
scenes.summary: Barinov leaves Elena a voicemail asking if she has seen his elephant, and Nagiyev wakes up in his office and confides in Vika.

scenes.title: Your Plan, Not Ours
scenes.summary: Max enthusiastically tells Vika they can get married in two years and have kids in five or six, and Vika quietly tells him that is his plan, not theirs.

scenes.title: The Door to the Future
scenes.summary: Katya gives Barinov back his lucky elephant, and while Max reflects on finding the right key to the future, Nagiyev tells Vika he loves her.
